usedFor: HelloLeads CRM holds leads, and Razorpay receives billing through “Create Payment Link” and “Create Invoice” once a lead is won.

bestTemplate.name: “When Lead Becomes Customer” in HelloLeads CRM, then “Create Invoice” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: A won lead is when billing starts, and the action creates an invoice with line items.

watchOut: “When Lead Becomes Customer” in HelloLeads CRM is polling, so “Create Invoice” runs after a scheduled check.
